anchors: check the rule's PROFILE before anything
never from inside an ssh session
decision: The Windows sshd setup enables OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP for every profile whether or not it already exists; key-only login sets PasswordAuthentication no AND KbdInteractiveAuthentication no; sshd is restarted from outside the ssh session and verified with ssh -o PreferredAuthentications=none.

evidence.text: Opus baseline-probe proposed a detached Start-Process restart from inside the session; opus and haiku quote-back on the new text answered all four questions from it. The PowerShell block parses under pwsh.

reopen_if: Windows OpenSSH starts creating its rule for every profile, or a restart from inside the session is shown to complete.
why: A create-if-missing firewall step found the install's Private-only rule and changed nothing, so port 22 was filtered on a Public NIC; with only PasswordAuthentication no, keyboard-interactive still prompted for the password; Restart-Service sshd run inside the session (even via a detached Start-Process) ended with the session and never completed. The opus baseline recommended that detached Start-Process route.
